_note: 學習路徑內容建置第4批 #4／6：反身代名詞（eng.t_mid.pron.reflexive，會考級）。主詞＝受詞時受詞用 myself/yourself/himself/herself/itself/ourselves/yourselves/themselves，須配對主詞；by + 反身代名詞＝自己一個人/沒人幫。theirselves 非標準字；themself 僅用於單數的 they，本單元主詞皆複數故用 themselves。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rf_）。

units.can_do: 我能在主詞和受詞是同一人時用反身代名詞（I hurt myself）、讓反身代名詞跟主詞正確配對（she→herself、they→themselves），並用 by myself 表示「自己一個人完成、沒有人幫」。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A reflexive pronoun (myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves) is used when the subject and the object are the same person: I hurt myself. She looked at herself in the mirror.
claims.verification_ref: 主詞＝受詞時用反身代名詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The reflexive pronoun must match the subject: I→myself, you (one)→yourself, he→himself, she→herself, it→itself, we→ourselves, you (more than one)→yourselves, they→themselves.
claims.verification_ref: 反身代名詞配對主詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'by + reflexive pronoun' means 'alone' or 'without help': I did my homework by myself. My little brother can tie his shoes by himself now.
claims.verification_ref: by + 反身代名詞＝自己一個人/沒人幫；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Reflexives use '-self' for a singular subject and '-selves' for a plural one; 'theirselves' is not standard English, and a plural 'they' takes 'themselves'. ('themself' exists only for a singular 'they'.)
claims.verification_ref: themselves 為標準形（theirselves／themself 非標準）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: When the person doing the action and the person receiving it are the same, use a reflexive pronoun as the object: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
teach.zh_hint: 當「做動作的人」和「被動作的對象」是同一個人時，受詞用反身代名詞：myself、yourself、himself、herself、itself、ourselves、yourselves、themselves。

teach.body: I hurt myself while cooking. She looked at herself in the mirror.
teach.zh_hint: 我煮飯時弄傷了自己。她看著鏡子裡的自己。主詞＝受詞。

teach.body: Match the reflexive pronoun to the subject: I -> myself, you -> yourself, he -> himself, she -> herself, we -> ourselves, they -> themselves. Note that plural 'they' takes 'themselves' (there is no 'theirselves'; 'themself' is only for singular 'they').
teach.zh_hint: 反身代名詞要跟主詞配對：I→myself、you→yourself、he→himself、she→herself、we→ourselves、they→themselves。注意複數的 they 要用 themselves（沒有 theirselves；themself 只用在單數的 they）。

teach.body: We taught ourselves to swim. They enjoyed themselves at the party.
teach.zh_hint: 我們自學游泳。他們在派對上玩得很開心。we→ourselves、they→themselves。

teach.body: 'by + reflexive pronoun' means 'alone, with no help from anyone else'.
teach.zh_hint: by + 反身代名詞 表示「自己一個人、沒有別人幫忙」。

teach.body: I finished my homework by myself.
teach.zh_hint: 我自己一個人寫完了功課。by myself＝自己完成。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：Be careful with the knife, or you might hurt ____.（小心刀子，不然你可能會弄傷自己。你＝一個人）

distractor_rationales.you: 主詞和受詞是同一人時要用反身代名詞 yourself，不是 you。
distractor_rationales.yourselves: yourselves 是「你們（不只一人）」；這裡對一個人說，用 yourself。
distractor_rationales.your: your 是「你的」（所有格），不是受詞。

practice.feedback: 主詞受詞同一人（你自己）用 yourself：you might hurt yourself。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：She introduced ____ to the new class.（她向新班級介紹自己。）

distractor_rationales.her: her 會變成「介紹別的女生」；介紹的是她自己，要用 herself。
distractor_rationales.she: she 是主格；受詞位置且和主詞同一人要用 herself。
distractor_rationales.himself: 主詞是 She，要用 herself，不是 himself。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：Danny fixed his bike by ____ yesterday.（Danny 昨天自己一個人修好腳踏車。自己一個人）

distractor_rationales.herself: Danny 是男生，要用 himself，不是 herself。
distractor_rationales.themselves: Danny 是一個人（單數），要用 himself。
distractor_rationales.his: his 是「他的」（所有格），不是反身代名詞。

practice.feedback: by himself＝自己一個人：fixed his bike by himself。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：The children behaved ____ during the whole concert.（整場音樂會孩子們都很守規矩。）

distractor_rationales.theirselves: theirselves 不是標準英文字；正確是 themselves。
distractor_rationales.themself: 這裡主詞是複數的 the children（they），要用 themselves；themself 只用於單數的 they。
distractor_rationales.them: them 是受格、指別人；和主詞同一群人、behave 作反身用時要用 themselves。

practice.feedback: 複數 they 配 themselves（不是 theirselves；themself 只用於單數 they）：behaved themselves。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：We made this cake ____; nobody helped us.（這個蛋糕是我們自己做的，沒有人幫忙。）

distractor_rationales.ourself: we 指我們這群人（複數），要用 ourselves。（ourself 僅用於以 we 自稱單一者的正式語氣，本句不是。）
distractor_rationales.themselves: 主詞是 We，要用 ourselves，不是 themselves。
distractor_rationales.us: us 是受格；這裡強調「我們自己動手」要用 ourselves。

practice.feedback: we 配 ourselves：We made this cake ourselves。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I made this card by myself, and my sister made one by herself too.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：by myself 和 by herself（都是『自己一個人完成』）有沒有配對正確、by 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。反身代名詞的重音在第二音節（my-SELF、her-SELF）；兩句句尾自然下收。

lines.text: I did it all by myself.
lines.intonation: 平穩、myself 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: She looked at herself in the mirror.
lines.intonation: 平穩、herself 稍強調、句尾下收
